annotations.title: Add directories to a launched project

description: Submits a launched project to more directories from its free allowance (no launch is spent). Refuses unless confirm_selected equals the directory count preview_launch returns for the same arguments. With a live key, clients that can ask their user (MCP elicitation) also get a question to confirm, and the answer does not pass through the model. An include longer than the free allowance answers allowance_exhausted; a directory already listed answers invalid_directories.

confirm_selected.description: The directory count from preview_launch that the user agreed to

directories.description: "auto" (best matches, highest DR first), {include: [ids]} exactly these, or {exclude: [ids]} auto without these

excluded_directories.description: Replaces the project's whole exclusion list for this request; [] clears it. directories: {exclude} leaves some out once instead

name: add_directories
